scoreProducts: Initial full row dots + progressive coordinate products + whole-prefix full calls. This includes short-prefix/fallback work; it is the primary exact logical score-work comparison.
sortCounterScope: Raw sortCalls/sortComparatorCalls count Python interval-maintenance sorting only. NumPy lexsort inside select is not instrumented by those counters. Zero sortCalls in full mode is not free sorting.
derivation: Every real query has a nonempty prefix. Full mode calls full -> select -> lexsort once per query/head. Certified mode calls full only on128short-prefix queries here; there are no ambiguity/range fallbacks. Verified from declared source/control flow and raw counters.
additionalCosts: Norm/bound/qualification/loop/array/library/constant arithmetic is represented by logical categories and measured phase time, not a complete hardware FLOP census. Internal NumPy sort comparisons are unmeasured. No net scalar-FLOP, energy or universal algorithmic speed claim.
zeroSavingsCaution: Pruning at coordinate128 saves0score products. A certified query can also save0products. Lead with total products including full calls and measured total time, not prunedKeys/certifiedQueries.
